# Product Picks

> Short product notes with referral links.

- [SoFi](https://ahshilshah.github.io/#sofi): 4.7% savings rate, clean interface, and banking, investing and crypto accounts that work together. No sweep account feature.
- [Bilt Palladium](https://ahshilshah.github.io/#bilt-palladium): Strong value for frequent American Airlines or Alaska Airlines flyers. Bilt Cash makes points easier to redeem, and Rent Day benefits are usable. Earning on rent payments involves complicated point calculations.
- [Capital One Venture X](https://ahshilshah.github.io/#capital-one-venture-x): Strong for miscellaneous spend at 2x miles and for Costco purchases. Annual fee offset by a travel credit. Strict rules around credit line increases.
- [Amex Delta SkyMiles Gold](https://ahshilshah.github.io/#amex-delta-gold): 15% off award tickets, 2 free checked bags, and a rideshare credit. Minimal annual fee.
- [Robinhood](https://ahshilshah.github.io/#robinhood): Mobile-first brokerage with a clean interface. Earn interest while selling options, lend stocks, and pay minimal contract fees.
